definitions.explanation: With an affirmative predicate, marks a feeling the speaker cannot quite put into words. Very common in なんとも{言|い}えない (indescribable) and before an adjective of impression.

definitions.gloss: not at all; nothing much; no problem
definitions.explanation: With a negative predicate, denies the whole of something — that anything is wrong, that anything can be said, or that anything is felt.

examples.japanese: なんとも⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧だ。
なんとも⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: What a strange story that is.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、なんとも⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧{気持|きも}ちになった。
examples.english: Seeing my hometown scenery after so long filled me with an indescribable nostalgia.

examples.japanese: なんとも⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧ならなんとも⟦{思|おも}わない→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Cold like this doesn't bother me in the least.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、なんとも⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げられません→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: Until the results are in, I cannot say anything at all.

notes:
From ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ + ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧. Which sense applies is decided entirely by whether the predicate is affirmative or negative, so read to the end of the clause before interpreting it.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- なんとも⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧: indescribable; impossible to say either way
- なんとも⟦{思|おも}わない→思う：00492_omou⟧: to think nothing of it, to be unbothered
- なんとも⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to be fine, to be nothing serious
- なんとも⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げられない→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: I am not in a position to comment (formal)

USAGE:
Sense 1 before an adjective is a warm, slightly literary intensifier: なんとも⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ (ever so beautiful). Sense 2's なんとも⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ is the standard reply to "are you hurt?" or "is anything wrong?".
